channel.title: Arun Kumar — Journalistic Archive
channel.description: Official archive of Arun Kumar (Senior Assistant Editor, Hindustan Times Patna Bureau) covering Bihar politics, higher education, Patna High Court jurisprudence, and governance.

item.title: No student will 'fail' in Class 10, 12: Bihar govt to replace it with 'Eligible for Skill Training' | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar will replace 'Fail' on Class 10 and 12 marksheets with 'Eligible for Skill Training', allowing students to pursue vocational training
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Chancellor's secretariat asks varsities to clear salary/pension backlogs by July 20 | Hindustan Times
item.description: The Chancellor's secretariat has asked all varsities to clear salaries to university teachers and employees, and pension and retirement benefits to retired ones by July 20 and submit status reports in the prescribed format, officials said on Sunday. Additional chief secretary (ACS) to the Governor, Dipak Kumar Singh, sent a letter to VCs in this regard.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: PK to contest Bankipur bypoll | Hindustan Times
item.description: Jan Suraaj Party announced Prashant Kishor as its candidate for Bankipur bypoll on July 30, aiming for political change in Bihar post-2025 elections.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Crucial Bankipur bypoll on July 30; to be test for BJP chief Nabin, Bihar CM Samrat on BJP home turf | Hindustan Times
item.description: The ECI announced by-elections for the Bankipur seat on July 30, with counting on August 3, amidst competition from RJD and Jan Suraaj Party.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar Lok Bhawan extends application deadline for VCs, P-VCs for larger pool | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar Governor's secretariat extends application deadline for vice chancellors and pro-vice chancellors to July 21, aiming for significant reforms in higher education.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: SC judge inaugurates interdisciplinary research unit at CNLU | Hindustan Times
item.description: Chanakya National Law University (CNLU), Patna, in collaboration with GIGA Innovations Technologies Pvt.Ltd., on Wednesday inaugurated the Cyber Security and Data Protection Compliance Research Unit (CS-DPCRU), a pioneering initiative dedicated to advancing research, policy development, capacity building, and industry collaboration in the fields of cyber security, data protection, privacy, and emerging technologies.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar misses July 1 deadline for 211 new colleges | Hindustan Times
item.description: The ambitious scheme announced the NDA government is a part of Saat Nischay-3 flagship programme and aims to expand higher education to every block of the state
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar starts training for state officials at ISTM to tone up administration | Hindustan Times
item.description: Bihar government trains administrative officers at ISTM to ensure compliance with service rules, aiming to reduce judicial scrutiny of disciplinary actions.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: RJD MP accuses Bihar Police's SVU of shielding 8 IAS officers in multi-crore tender fraud | Hindustan Times
item.description: Sudhakar Singh alleged that while second rung officials were being arrested, the senior IAS officials had been let off despite ED's clear indications at whose behest junior officials operated without fear
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: PM lauds Nalanda University's initiative to protect ancient tradition in line with tech era | Hindustan Times
item.description: Prime Minister remarked that Nalanda's knowledge tradition, which flourished thousands of years ago, is once again guiding India's future in a renewed form
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Bihar to have new Act to govern state varsities | Hindustan Times
item.description: The new law will incorporate best practices adopted by 15 other states and also key features of similar acts prevalent there
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Patna HC criticises 'autocratic action' of state on decades old land ownership | Hindustan Times
item.description: Hearing his civil writ petition, a single-judge bench of Justice Sourendra Pandey ordered the local administration to immediately resume issuing rent receipts to the petitioner
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: Teachers' shortage prompts Bihar govt to widen hiring ambit for degree colleges | Hindustan Times
item.description: Education department secretary Rajiv Raushan wrote to all the district education officers (DEOs) for details of eligible Class 9-10 school teachers after verification for deputation in degree colleges. Earlier, it was only for Class 11-12.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)

item.title: JD(U) won't disintegrate like TMC, UBT: Sanjay Jha | Hindustan Times
item.description: Jha said that at the National Council meeting on Sunday, Nitish Kumar himself indicated that he would devote more time to the organisation to ensure even better performance in the future and facilitate a smooth generational transition.
item.author: arunkumar.htpatna@gmail.com (Arun Kumar)
